author: claude-code
content:
Researched and designed Antigravity CLI (agy) runtime support for crosslink. Design doc at .design/antigravity-runtime-support.md is fully locked and ready for implementation. Active issue: L4.

WHAT WAS DONE:
- Researched Google Antigravity (announced Google I/O 2026, agy CLI, Gemini-powered, replaces Gemini CLI)
- Confirmed all technical details needed for implementation via user testing + web research
- Wrote complete design doc at .design/antigravity-runtime-support.md

KEY CONFIRMED FACTS:
- Binary: agy, non-interactive: agy -p 'prompt', flag: --dangerously-skip-permissions (same as Claude Code)
- Project config dir: .agents/ (analogous to .claude/)
- Project instructions: AGENTS.md (analogous to CLAUDE.md)
- Skills: .agents/skills/*.md (analogous to .claude/commands/*.md)
- Hooks: .agents/hooks.json -- format CONFIRMED from live file: named top-level objects with enabled flag, events: PreInvocation/PostInvocation/PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop, same matcher/type/command/timeout fields as Claude Code settings.json
- MCP: .agents/mcp_config.json at project root (separate from .mcp.json)
- session-start.py already idempotent (crosslink session start no-ops if active)
- Worktree isolation non-issue: .agents/ is in working tree, each worktree gets its own copy

WHAT TO IMPLEMENT (PR 1 checklist in design doc):
1. AgentRuntime enum (Claude/Antigravity/Both) in init/mod.rs
2. --runtime flag on crosslink init (persisted to hook-config.json as agent_runtime key)
3. resources/antigravity/ directory with hooks.json, mcp_config.json, skills/*.md
4. Extend build.rs to emit SKILL_FILES const
5. Extend managed_files() to accept runtime param
6. Extend run() to write .agents/ tree when runtime wants_antigravity()
7. write_hooks_json_merged() -- upsert 'crosslink' key, preserve all others
8. write_mcp_config_merged() for mcp_config.json  
9. write_agents_md() with marker-based section merge (like gitignore)
10. Extend gitignore managed section with .agents/ entries
11. Extend workflow.rs drift detection for .agents/
12. Extend style.rs path mappings for .agents/hooks and .agents/skills
13. Integration tests for --runtime antigravity and --runtime both
Kickoff (Phase 2, separate PR): build_agy_command() in launch.rs -- simpler than Claude Code, no CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR needed

OPEN: Gemini model pricing for token_usage.rs -- can land in separate small PR, not blocking.
